understanding.goal_understanding: Navigate the grid and complete every level by matching the carried piece's shape, color, and rotation to each goal, then stepping onto the goal cell.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement uses directional actions and can be blocked by walls. Each move consumes stamina; when stamina reaches zero, a life is lost and stamina resets, while losing all lives ends the game. Modifier tiles alter the carried piece: shape changers cycle shape, color changers cycle color, and rotation changers rotate it 90 degrees clockwise. A goal activates only when all three attributes match simultaneously. In this episode, the piece had rotation 270 degrees but needed 0 degrees, requiring reaching the rotation changer at [19,30] before returning to the goal at [34,10].
